editorial.blurb: This beloved seafood-American spot draws crowds with consistently excellent food, gracious service, and a warm atmosphere that feels both celebratory and relaxed.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation—reviewers emphasize this repeatedly, especially for weekends. Ask your server (like Kevin or Tony) for recommendations; they're notably knowledgeable about the menu.

topDishes.note: curry has the right heat, rabbit melts in your mouth
